name: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset
description: The BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset was developed by researchers at the University of Oxford and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, published in IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering and hosted on PhysioNet. Extracted from the MIMIC-II matched waveform database, the dataset contains 53 recordings of physiological signals from critically ill patients (aged 19–90+ years) admitted to intensive care. Each record spans 8 minutes and captures continuous photoplethysmogram (PPG), impedance pneumography respiratory signal, and lead II electrocardiogram (ECG) sampled at 125 Hz. Ground-truth respiratory rate annotations were manually labeled by two independent human annotators inspecting impedance breaths, providing an authoritative benchmark for non-invasive respiratory rate estimation and pulse oximeter waveform analysis.
